item.title: Burnout among farmers a big issue says Co Cavan farmer
item.description: A Cavan woman has said that financial security and planning for the future is a big issue facing farmers. Sophie Bell is a young farmer from Cavan who has shared her experience of the farm life on social media. She was speaking as the Health and Safety Authority has launched a week-long inspection campaign highlighting risks of certain health and wellness conditions due to the nature of their environment. item.description: The Dáil has heard there is extraordinary public anger over the withdrawal of blister packs being issued by pharmacies to vulnerable patients. Minister Patrick O'Donovan said medical card holders have their expenses capped at 80 euro a month. item.title: Cavan based vet issues warning over dangers of using anti-freeze
item.description: A Co Cavan based vet has issued a warning surrounding the use of anti-freeze. Aoife Flanagan is a vet from the Cavan vet clinic is reminding motorists to keep bottles of anti-freeze away from their pets as it can be lethal if consumed. If consumed by pets it can prove fatal, so you are being called on to be extra careful when using it and storing it away. item.title: Fivemiletown on Russian list of strike targets
item.description: A Russian politician has warned a County Tyrone town, which is situated close to the border, is on a ‘strike list’ should war break out between Russia and Europe. Former Deputy Prime Minister, Dmitry Rogozin, named 23 sites in the UK which would be attacked in the event of a conflict. Fivemiletown and Belfast in the North, both of which are home to facilities which manufacture military weapons, were named as targeted areas. item.title: Baby boy dies in Dundalk following weekend collision
item.description: Gardaí continue to investigate a two-car road traffic collision on the R132 at Dowdallshill in Dundalk, Co Louth, on Saturday 6th December 2025. The infant boy, a passenger in one of the cars, has since passed away at Children's Health Ireland, Temple Street. Gardaí continue to appeal for anyone who witnessed this collision to come forward. item.title: Dernawilt Road closed due to ‘serious‘ road crash
item.description: The Dernawilt Road near the village of Roslea is closed due to a serious road traffic collision. In a statement issued to Northern Sound, the PSNI stated: “Road users are advised the Dernawilt Road, Lisnaskea is currently closed following a serious road traffic collision this evening, diversions are in place.
